Overview

Guayaquil is a city in G with a population of 2,700,000. Ecuador’s largest city and main Pacific port, a bustling economic hub with a revitalized riverfront. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
